summary: Three listed churches (Nativity BVM Williamsville, Sacred Heart Bowmansville, St. Mary's Swormville) share one bulletin whose page 3 Mass box and page 4 Confession and Adoration lists are stable across all four issues. Weekend and daily Masses, the first-Friday and first-Saturday services at Sacred Heart, Wednesday Adoration at Nativity and Saturday Confessions are settled. St. Mary's Mon-Thu 9:00 AM Mass is in its chapel. No open questions.
